references.text: Urim and Thummim were placed in the breastpiece of the high priest and used to seek the Lord's will.
Moses placed Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece when he consecrated Aaron as a priest.
Moses' blessing over Levi mentions Urim and Thummim as belonging to the faithful man.
Saul used Urim to seek God's will regarding who had sinned.
The Lord did not answer Saul, neither by dreams, nor by Urim, nor by prophets.
Some were forbidden to eat from the most holy things until a priest with Urim and Thummim appeared.
Parallel to Ezra 2:63 about waiting for a priest with Urim and Thummim.
Eleazar was the son of Aaron and was consecrated as a priest to serve before the Lord.
Eleazar succeeded his father Aaron as high priest.
The Israelites did not seek the Lord's counsel before making a covenant with the Gibeonites—an example of the consequences of failing to seek the Lord's will.
